defect: The added repetition loop reuses the variable i in the inner loop, shadowing the outer counter so username/password placeholders are repeated the wrong number of times.
reason: The fix only renames the inner loop variable in the lines this change added, and the shadowing is plainly visible in the diff.

defect: The fix swaps the shortcuts back so Ctrl+N creates a new entry and Ctrl+Shift+N a new database.
reason: This is a reverted shortcut preference, not a functional defect; neither assignment is broken.

defect: The excluded-characters text is passed to setCustomCharacterSet, overwriting the additional characters and never excluding anything.
reason: The fix replaces exactly that added call with setExcludedCharacterSet, and the copy-paste error is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix holds groups in QPointer so a group deleted by a merge during import is skipped instead of dereferenced.
reason: The old code already kept raw Group pointers in the update list and imported shares inside the same loop, so the use-after-delete predates this change.

defect: The fix changes the Mac data path from ../Resources/keepassx to ../Resources.
reason: This change only added the missing parenthesis; the wrong path string was already there before it.

defect: With best-match enabled, the added handleURL branch rejects entries unless host and path match exactly, so entries saved as a plain domain or subdomain no longer match pages with a path; the new fullUrl priority also compares an unnormalized URL.
reason: The fix removes the added best-match filter from handleURL and rewrites the priority logic the change introduced; the over-strict path comparison can be seen in the diff.

defect: When AutoSaveAfterEveryChange is on, every modification wipes the LastDatabases config entry (the recent databases list).
reason: The fix deletes exactly that added block, and a reader of the diff can see it is unrelated to auto-save and destroys user data.

defect: The fix renames setWordlist and setWordseparator to camel case.
reason: This is a pure naming refactor with no behaviour change.

defect: The fix renames setWordlist and setWordseparator to setWordList and setWordSeparator.
reason: This is a pure naming refactor with no behaviour change.

defect: The fix renames canDeleteCurrentGoup to canDeleteCurrentGroup.
reason: The typo existed before this const-ification change and renaming it changes no behaviour.

defect: The fix updates test expectations, for example comparing against urls[0] instead of a literal, and adds new URL-matching tests.
reason: This is a test change that follows the matching rewrite; the added test was not wrong.

defect: The fix makes cancel() honour commitEntry failure, stop resetting the generator on cancel and emit an explicit accepted flag.
reason: This change only swapped QMessageBox enums for MessageBox enums; the cancel logic the fix repairs predates it.

defect: The added guard calls isPasswordVisible(), which returns isEnabled(), so the password field is never re-obscured when a database is opened.
reason: The fix restores the unconditional setShowPassword(false), but it is unclear whether this repairs a defect or reverses a deliberate behaviour change.

defect: On non-Windows systems the proxy file dialog filter is *.*, which hides executables that have no extension.
reason: The fix changes exactly the added filter string to *, and the problem is visible in the diff.

defect: autoTypeSequences appends a sequence for every matching association, title match and URL match, so the same entry and sequence show up several times in the global auto-type selection.
reason: The duplicates come from the new accumulate-without-break logic in this change, and the fix de-duplicates them with toSet.

defect: The generator popup's closed handler always sends the error message to the browser, even after a password was generated and sent.
reason: The fix guards that added send with isPasswordGenerated; seeing the problem needs the popup's close-after-apply behaviour from PasswordGeneratorWidget.

defect: The fix reads SSH agent attachments through attachmentsWidget instead of m_entryAttachments, after a separate attachment refactor.
reason: The regression came from the later entry-attachment refactor; this change used m_entryAttachments just as the code before it did.

defect: The fix adds braces so the > prompt is printed only after a non-empty input line.
reason: The missing braces only cause an extra prompt after empty lines, a misleading-indentation cleanup rather than a real wrong result.

defect: The QTemporaryFile template has no XXXXXX placeholder, so Qt appends a random suffix and the opened attachment loses its file extension.
reason: The fix puts XXXXXX at the start of the added template so the original suffix is kept, and the template is in the diff.

defect: The fix reformats code style and wraps the AutoType dialog titles in tr().
reason: This is a formatting and translation cleanup, not a repair of a functional defect.

defect: The fix reformats the declarations in AutoType.h.
reason: This is a pure code-style change.

defect: The tab name is built with arg(db->metadata()->name().arg(filename)), so arg is applied to the name instead of the format string and the tab text is wrong.
reason: The misplaced parenthesis is in the newly added updateTabName, and the fix corrects that expression.

defect: m_shareLabel is declared only under WITH_XC_KEESHARE, but the same commit uses it unconditionally in DatabaseWidget::search(), so the build fails without KeeShare.
reason: The fix removes the added ifdef around the member; the unconditional use is in DatabaseWidget.cpp.

defect: The new componentWidgetLayout->isEmpty() test is also true when the existing component widget is merely hidden, so a second edit widget is added and a double password field appears.
reason: The fix replaces that added layout check with an explicit m_componentWidget pointer.

defect: The fix adds static_cast<quint32> to signed/unsigned comparisons to silence compiler warnings.
reason: The usual arithmetic conversions already compared these as unsigned, so behaviour is unchanged and only warnings are fixed.

defect: The fix makes countToText static.
reason: This is a style change with no behaviour difference in this file.

defect: The Hide toolbar setting is read only in the MainWindow constructor, so changing it in the settings has no effect until restart.
reason: The fix moves the added line into applySettingsChanges; seeing the problem needs the settings-apply path.

defect: The fix removes the KEEPASSXC_DIST_SNAP ifdefs whose two branches had become identical.
reason: The FilePath.cpp part is a simplification; the snap compile error the commit names is in Bootstrap.cpp, not in this file.

defect: The fix rewrites the const test objects as const auto x = T{} to satisfy GCC.
reason: This is a test-only change to how the objects are initialized.

defect: The fix removes the braces added around a single statement in writeRaw.
reason: This is a style revert with no behaviour change; the Host-header fix is in another file.

defect: QUrl::port() returns -1 when no port is given, which stored in a quint16 becomes 65535, so the Host header always carries :65535.
reason: The defect is in the newly added prepareHeadersToWrite, and the fix replaces that port handling.

defect: saveEntry calls setExpires and setExpiryTime on the temporary returned by Entry::timeInfo(), so the expiry changes are thrown away.
reason: Entry::timeInfo() returns TimeInfo by value (Entry.h), and the fix switches to the Entry setters for these added lines.

defect: Argument parsing starts at index 0, the program path, which always exists, so the executable itself is treated as the database filename.
reason: The fix starts the added loop at 1, and the off-by-one is visible in the diff.

defect: handleURL now tests entryQUrl.host().endsWith(baseDomain(hostname)), so every entry under the same base domain matches regardless of subdomain.
reason: The fix reverts that added comparison to siteHost.endsWith(entryHost) and drops the baseDomain call.

defect: The incremental tags-menu update removes stale actions with deleteLater after the menu's empty check, keeps the No Tags placeholder, reuses actions across databases and appends new tags out of order.
reason: The fix reorders deletion before insertion, deletes immediately and clears the menu on tab change, repairing the logic this change added.

defect: The fix renames openDatabases to m_openDatabases and takes the slot argument by const reference.
reason: This is a coding-style rename with no behaviour change.

defect: The per-QAction event filter added to handle the copy shortcut never fires on macOS, so Copy Password still overrides copying the selected text there.
reason: The fix replaces the added filter with a ShortcutOverride handler; the macOS failure comes from Qt behaviour that the code does not show.

defect: The reply length prefix uses QString::length() (UTF-16 units) instead of the UTF-8 byte count, so messages with non-ASCII characters get the wrong size.
reason: The fix computes the length from toUtf8() in the newly added sendReply.

defect: After a sort proxy is put in front of the history view, view indices are still passed straight to the source model, so activating, showing, restoring or deleting acts on the wrong history item.
reason: This change added the proxy without mapping indices, and the fix adds mapToSource in those handlers.

defect: The new resource-dir probe requires icons/application/256x256/apps/keepassxc.png, which a build-directory share folder lacks now that icons are bundled, so the data path (wordlists, translations) is not found when running from the build directory.
reason: The fix replaces the added file probe and lookup order with a directory-exists check; this follows from the build layout in share/CMakeLists.txt.
